description: This file defines functions and constants related to skill configuration management in the openclaw project, including resolving skill configs, checking if skills are bundled or allowed, and evaluating runtime eligibility based on environment and config.

methods.name: isConfigPathTruthy
methods.description: Checks if a configuration path is truthy with default values.

methods.name: resolveSkillConfig
methods.description: Resolves and returns the skill configuration for a given skill key from the overall config.

methods.name: normalizeAllowlist
methods.description: Normalizes an input list into an array of strings, or returns undefined if invalid.

methods.name: resolveBundledAllowlist
methods.description: Returns the allowlist of bundled skills from the config.

methods.name: isBundledSkillAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a bundled skill is allowed based on the allowlist.

methods.name: shouldIncludeSkill
methods.description: Decides whether a skill should be included based on config, eligibility, and other criteria.
